lead_headline: Workflow SDK patches a path-traversal vulnerability and ships two releases in a single afternoon
lead_body: A path-traversal flaw in world-local ID validation was backported to stable and forward-ported to main within minutes, landing alongside a 4.2.5 release and the morning's 5.0.0-beta.7. AI SDK added Claude Platform on AWS, Vercel token support, and a serviceTier gateway option — all backported to the release branch before day's end.
lead_article:
Workflow SDK dominated the day. The headline is a security patch: a path-traversal vulnerability in world-local ID validation was backported to stable as PR #1920, then immediately forward-ported to main — the kind of fix that ships fast and quiet for good reason. That landed alongside a release of 4.2.5, and the beta line moved to 5.0.0-beta.7 earlier in the morning. Beneath the security work, a meaningful performance fix resolved an event-cursor bug that had been causing degradation after initial load — the clobbered cursor commit touched both main and stable branches. The Attributes MVP PR opened at 15:44, marked experimental and write-only, which is the shape of a feature being felt out carefully before it gets surface area. The swc-plugin picked up two correctness fixes: lexical `this` capture for nested arrow step functions, and preserved imports referenced by hoisted nested steps — both the kind of subtle compiler behavior that surfaces only under real usage.

AI SDK had a full day of its own. Claude Platform on AWS landed as a new provider, Vercel access token support arrived in the gateway, and a `serviceTier` option was added to `GatewayProviderOptions` — all backported to the release branch within hours of merging. An issue opened late in the afternoon for auto-injecting `skip_thought_signature_validator` on Gemini 3 tool-call replays, with two PRs already open against it before the day closed. Astro resolved several issues simultaneously: dev-mode styles missing from content collection entries, dangling pure CSS chunk imports when `assetQueryParams` is set, and a Cloudflare adapter assets-directory path miscalculation. The external stylesheet URL population for prerendered routes also merged. Claude Code shipped two releases — v2.1.148 and v2.1.149 — while accumulating a substantial bug queue around MCP reliability on Windows, a missing shebang on the Windows binary stub, and sub-agent idle behavior. The workload identity federation PR for CI auth opened and merged within the same hour, which was the day's tidiest loop.
